features.quote: every shell command also runs under a wall-clock `command_timeout`
features.justification_quote: if pytest actually executed an infinite-loop function, the run would hang

features.quote: a standard think→act→observe cycle with a step cap
gives the agent a **clean, first-class way to say "impossible"**
features.justification_quote: It makes honest behavior *easy*, so an agent that still cheats can't blame the lack of an honest exit
